This notice should be read with MSN 1886 (M+F), MSN 1905 (M+F), the Code of Safe Working Practices for Merchant Seafarers, Wellbeing at Sea: A Pocket Guide for Seafarers and the Ship Captain’s Medical Guide and replaces MGN 652 (M+F).

Notice to

shipowners (including fishing vessel owners)

employers

manning agencies

port operators

ship masters

seafarers and fishermen
